connector.name: Ziggs
connector.registryDescription: Ziggs delegate MCP: chat, agreements, context, payments via OAuth or operator key.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.ziggsai.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package ziggs-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ziggsai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: ZIGGS_OPERATOR_KEY
env.description: Agent-scoped Ziggs operator key (stdio path). Remote OAuth does not need this.
